title: Label Contract
description: Defines how training labels are generated from price data. A Label Contract is the mathematical expression of a trading hypothesis — it specifies what the model is trying to predict. See blueprints/TRAINING_BLUEPRINT.md.

type.description: survival_barrier: which barrier hits first within horizon. regression: future N-bar return. binary_class: direction up/down.

horizon_bars.description: Number of bars in the forward window (e.g. 12 M5 bars = 60 minutes)

bar_timeframe.description: Timeframe of bars used for horizon

sl_atr_mult.description: Stop-loss distance as multiple of ATR

tp_atr_mult.description: Take-profit distance as multiple of ATR

label_classes.description: Mapping from integer label values to semantic class names. For survival_barrier: {"1": "tp_hit_first", "0": "timeout", "-1": "sl_hit_first"}. For regression: value = forward return. For binary_class: {"1": "up", "0": "down"}.

timeout_label.description: Semantic class for samples that hit neither barrier within horizon

metadata.description: Optional documentation fields (author, rationale, regime_notes, etc.)
